data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'fredus', meaning 'peaceful'. The suffix '-ella' is a diminutive form, making this name a pet form of a peaceful protector. The name Fredella carries the meaning “Peaceful protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Fredella usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
